normalized.result:
Adding and removing tags feels light and natural, and the existing-tag suggestions are exactly what I’d want. Keeping the tag filter within the current All, Unread, or Archived view also makes sense.

Clicking one tag is a good quick filter, but I would also want to select several tags so I can narrow the list to links carrying all of them. The current single-tag behavior is still useful and approved.

One small wording change: “Show all tags” sounds like it will display a list of tags. “Clear tag filter” or “Show all links” would describe what it actually does more clearly.
